title: Bitwarden Seeder Preset
description: Defines a complete seeding preset for either an organization or an individual user account.

organization.description: Organization configuration. Use 'fixture' for a named fixture, or 'name'+'domain' for inline creation.

fixture.description: Name of an organization fixture file (e.g., 'dunder-mifflin').

name.description: Organization display name (used with inline creation).

domain.description: Organization domain (used with inline creation and generator seeding).

claimedDomains.description: Claimed (verified) organization domains to seed. Each becomes a verified OrganizationDomain row.

seats.description: Number of seats in the organization.

planType.description: Billing plan type. Defaults to enterprise-annually if omitted.

useAutomaticUserConfirmation.description: When true, invited users are automatically confirmed without manual admin approval.

allowAdminAccessToAllCollectionItems.description: When true, admins, owners, and some custom users can read/write all collections and items.

limitItemDeletion.description: When true, members can only delete items when they have Can Manage permission.

limitCollectionCreation.description: When true, only owners, admins, and some custom users can create collections.

limitCollectionDeletion.description: When true, only owners, admins, and some custom users can delete collections.

roster.description: Named roster fixture for users, groups, and collections.

fixture.description: Name of a roster fixture file (e.g., 'dunder-mifflin').

realisticStatusMix.description: When true and count >= 10, creates realistic mix: 85% Confirmed, 5% Invited, 5% Accepted, 5% Revoked.

adminCount.description: Number of confirmed generated members created as Admins (the rest are Users).

statusMix.description: Explicit member status weights (normalized). Overrides realisticStatusMix.

groups.description: Generate random groups with user assignment. Distribution shape is configurable via the density block.

collections.description: Generate random collections with user and group assignments. Access patterns are configurable via the density block.

folders.description: When true, generates folders for each user using a realistic distribution.

folderNames.description: Named folders to create for an individual user. Referenced by folderAssignments.

ciphers.description: Cipher configuration. Use 'fixture' for a named fixture, or 'count' for random generation.

fixture.description: Name of a cipher fixture file (e.g., 'autofill-testing').

count.description: Number of random ciphers to generate.

assignFolders.description: When true, assigns generated ciphers to user folders round-robin. Requires 'folders' to be true.

repromptEveryNthCipher.description: Set Reprompt=Password on every Nth generated cipher. 0 = disabled.

personalCiphers.description: Generate personal ciphers for each user's personal vault.

countPerUser.description: Number of personal ciphers to generate per user.

repromptEveryNthCipher.description: Set Reprompt=Password on every Nth generated personal cipher. 0 = disabled.

enableAll.description: Not supported: a preset that sets it fails to load. List types in 'enable' instead.

except.description: Not supported: a preset that sets it fails to load.

enable.description: PolicyType names to create as enabled policies (e.g. organizationDataOwnership). OrganizationDataOwnership gets {"enableIndividualItemsTransfer":true}.

disable.description: PolicyType names to create as disabled policy rows.

data.description: Policy Data JSON keyed by PolicyType name; overrides the built-in default.

accessShape.description: Production-calibrated access shape (overlapping groups, long-tailed collection sizes, explicit grant pairing). When present, replaces the density group/collection/cipher-assignment algorithms. See Seeds/docs/access-shape.md.

inactiveAccessRate.description: Fraction of invited, accepted and revoked members who copy a random confirmed member's group memberships (except the everyone group) and direct grants.

departments.description: Org-structure locality for groups, grants and multi-collection items.

everyoneGroupRate.description: Fraction of confirmed members in one 'Everyone' group (0 = none).

hotGroupSizes.description: Exact member counts for hot groups.

hotGroupOverlap.description: Fraction of each later hot group's members drawn from its parent hot group.

nestedGroupRate.description: Fraction of regular groups built as a subset of a larger group in the same department.

maxGroupsPerUser.description: Cap on groups per member, including the everyone group.

userAffinityAlpha.description: Pareto exponent for member group affinity; lower = heavier tail.

sizes.description: Member-count histogram for the regular groups.

hotGroupParents.description: Parent hot group index per hot group (-1 = none), for chains like C inside B inside A. Default: every later hot group draws from the first.

totalAssignments.description: Total collection-cipher rows on shared collections (histogram draws are scaled to it).

sizes.description: Item-count histogram for shared collections; a 0-0 bucket makes empty collections.

grantedGroupRate.description: Fraction of regular groups eligible for random grants, largest first; the smallest groups get none.

groupSizeBias.description: Group pick weight = members^-bias; higher favors small groups.

groupAppetiteAlpha.description: Pareto exponent for per-group grant appetite; lower = a few groups hold most grants.

collectionPopularityAlpha.description: Pareto exponent for per-collection grant popularity.

collectionSizeBias.description: Collection pick weight multiplier = (items+1)^bias; negative favors small collections.

echoRate.description: Fraction of grants copied to a nested child or overlapping smaller group.

everyoneGroupCollections.description: Tiny collections granted to the everyone group.

hotCollections.description: Exact item counts of the collections reserved for hot pairs.

maxGrantsPerGroup.description: Cap on random grants per group (hot and wide grants excluded).

wideGroups.description: Tiny groups granted nested prefixes of one block of near-empty collections (admin-style wide reach with few items).

blockMaxItems.description: Only collections with at most this many items go into the block.

minGrants.description: Minimum grants per wide group (log-uniform; the first wide group gets maxGrants).

maxMembers.description: Wide groups are picked from regular groups with at most this many members.

total.description: Total CollectionUser rows on shared collections.

collectionSizeBias.description: Collection pick weight = (items+1)^bias; higher favors big collections.

userAffinityAlpha.description: Pareto exponent for member direct-grant affinity.

ungroupedBoost.description: Weight multiplier for members in no group other than the everyone group.

myItems.description: My Items (default user) collections for every confirmed member, as created by the Organization Data Ownership policy, filled with already-migrated org ciphers.

name.description: Plaintext collection name, encrypted once with the org key.

deletedRate.description: Trashed items added per member, as a fraction of that member's active My Items items.

nonEmptyRate.description: Fraction of My Items collections holding at least one item.

largest.description: Exact item counts for the heaviest members.

policyEnabledDaysAgo.description: Days before now the policy was enabled; items migrate between then and now.

sizes.description: Item-count histogram for non-empty My Items collections.

sso.description: Single Sign-On configuration for the organization.

identifier.description: SSO organization identifier used in login flows.

encryptionType.description: How member keys are protected. 'masterPassword' = standard SSO, 'trustedDevices' = TDE (no master password), 'keyConnector' = Key Connector.

collectionAssignments.description: Maps ciphers to specific collections. Each entry is a (cipher, collection) tuple. When present, replaces round-robin collection assignment.

cipher.description: Cipher name from the cipher fixture.

folderAssignments.description: Maps ciphers to specific folders for specific users. Each entry is a (cipher, user, folder) tuple.

cipher.description: Cipher name from the cipher fixture.

folder.description: Folder name from the user's folders in the roster.

user.description: User email prefix (e.g., 'john.doe') from the roster.

favoriteAssignments.description: Marks specific ciphers as favorites for specific users. Each entry is a (cipher, user) tuple.

cipher.description: Cipher name from the cipher fixture.

user.description: User email prefix (e.g., 'john.doe') from the roster.

kdfIterations.description: KDF iteration count for all seeded users. Defaults to 5,000 for fast seeding. Use 600,000 for production-realistic e2e testing.

density.description: Density profile controlling how users, groups, collections, and ciphers relate within the seeded organization.

membership.description: How users are distributed across groups.

shape.description: How users spread across groups. 'uniform' = equal sizes, 'powerLaw' = few large groups and many small, 'megaGroup' = one group gets 90%+ of users.

skew.description: Skew intensity for powerLaw and megaGroup shapes. Ignored for uniform.

collectionFanOut.description: How collections are assigned to groups.

min.description: Minimum collections assigned per non-empty group.

max.description: Maximum collections assigned per non-empty group.

shape.description: How collections spread across groups. 'uniform' = equal counts, 'powerLaw' = few groups get many collections, 'frontLoaded' = first 10% of collections get max fan-out, rest get min.

emptyGroupRate.description: Fraction of groups that have zero users assigned to them (0.0-1.0).

directAccessRatio.description: Fraction of access paths that are direct CollectionUser assignments. 1.0 = all direct, 0.0 = all group-mediated.

permissions.description: How Manage, ReadOnly, HidePasswords, and ReadWrite permissions are distributed across collection access assignments.

manage.description: Weight for Manage permission (0.0-1.0). All four weights must sum to 1.0.

readOnly.description: Weight for ReadOnly permission (0.0-1.0). All four weights must sum to 1.0.

hidePasswords.description: Weight for HidePasswords permission (0.0-1.0). All four weights must sum to 1.0.

readWrite.description: Weight for ReadWrite permission (0.0-1.0). All four weights must sum to 1.0.

cipherAssignment.description: How ciphers are distributed across collections.

skew.description: How ciphers spread across collections. 'uniform' = equal counts, 'heavyRight' = few collections hold most ciphers while most collections are sparse.

orphanRate.description: Fraction of org ciphers with no collection assignment.

multiCollectionRate.description: Fraction of non-orphan ciphers assigned to more than one collection. Default: 0.

maxCollectionsPerCipher.description: Maximum number of collections a multi-collection cipher can belong to. Default: 2.

archivedRate.description: Fraction of ciphers that get an archived state. Applies independently to both the personal-vault and org cipher pools, each against its own size and maxArchivedCiphers cap. Default: 0.

deletedRate.description: Fraction of personal-vault and org ciphers that get a deleted (DeletedDate) state, computed independently per pool. Default: 0.

archivedAndDeletedOverlapRate.description: Fraction of the eligible cipher pool (personal or org, computed independently per pool) deliberately made both archived and deleted. Drawn from the archived set. Default: 0.

maxArchivedCiphers.description: Absolute cap on archived ciphers produced in one run. Default: 50.

maxDeletedCiphers.description: Absolute cap on deleted ciphers produced in one run. Default: 25.

userCollections.description: How many direct collections each user receives via CollectionUser records.

min.description: Minimum direct collections per user. Default: 1.

max.description: Maximum direct collections per user. Default: 3.

shape.description: Distribution shape for user-collection assignments. Default: uniform.

skew.description: Skew intensity for powerLaw shape. Ignored for uniform/frontLoaded. Default: 0.

cipherTypes.description: Cipher type distribution for generated ciphers. Use 'preset' for a named distribution or specify custom weights per type.

preset.description: Named cipher type distribution. Mutually exclusive with custom weights.

login.description: Weight for Login ciphers. All custom weights must sum to 1.0.

personalCiphers.description: Personal cipher count distribution per user. Overrides the top-level personalCiphers.countPerUser with a variable distribution.

shape.description: Named distribution for personal cipher counts per user. Default: flat countPerUser.

folders.description: Folder count distribution per user. Overrides the default realistic distribution.

shape.description: Named folder count distribution. Default: realistic.

user.description: Individual user account configuration. Mutually exclusive with 'organization'.

email.description: Email address for the individual user account.

premium.description: Whether the user has a premium subscription.

maxStorageGb.description: Maximum storage in GB. Use 0 for no storage, 1-5 for premium users. Values above 5 are clamped to 5.
